paper_record.title: Raman spectroscopy of van der Waals topological magnet GdGaI
paper_record.abstract: We report polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy of a van der Waals compound GdGaI that is a candidate for excitonic insulators. By combining the symmetry analysis with density functional theory calculations, we identify six Raman-active phonons. The spectra exhibit only the expected anharmonic hardening down to 4 K: no additional peaks, no soft modes, and no signatures of zone folding are observed. This result indicates that any lattice distortion is below our experimental sensitivity, supporting an electronically driven origin for the band reconstruction reported by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy rather than an electron-phonon-driven mechanism. Moreover, we observe a pronounced circular dichroism of the $A_{1g}$ modes under an out-of-plane magnetic field. Based on symmetry considerations, we attribute this dichroic response to chiral $A_{1g}$ phonons with opposite angular momenta generated by spin-phonon coupling in the time-reversal-broken state. The temperature evolution of the degree of circular polarization further suggests that circularly polarized Raman spectroscopy detects the emergence of short-range antiferromagnetic correlations. Our results highlight GdGaI as a promising platform in which excitonic order, magnetism, and circularly polarized phonons can be intertwined, and demonstrate that circular-polarization Raman provides a sensitive probe of spin-phonon coupling in excitonic systems.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 通过偏振拉曼光谱证实了GdGaI中的能带重构源于电子驱动机制，并发现了磁场诱导的手性声子行为。
one_sentence_summary.en: Polarized Raman spectroscopy confirms the electronically driven origin of band reconstruction in GdGaI and reveals magnetic-field-induced chiral phonons.

problem.zh: 厘清候选激子绝缘体GdGaI中的能带重构是由电子相互作用（激子机制）还是电-声子耦合（电荷密度波机制）驱动的。
problem.en: To determine whether the band reconstruction in the candidate excitonic insulator GdGaI is driven by electron-electron interactions (excitonic mechanism) or electron-phonon coupling (charge-density-wave mechanism).

approach.zh: 结合偏振分辨拉曼光谱实验（温度低至4 K，磁场高达9 T）与密度泛函理论（DFT）声子计算及对称性分析。
approach.en: Combining polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy (down to 4 K and up to 9 T) with density functional theory (DFT) phonon calculations and symmetry analysis.

main_takeaway.zh: 降温过程中未发现晶格畸变或声子软化，证实能带重构为电子驱动；同时在磁场下观测到A1g声子的显著圆二色性，源于自旋-声子耦合产生的手性声子。
main_takeaway.en: No evidence of lattice distortion or phonon softening was found upon cooling, confirming an electronically driven band reconstruction, while a pronounced circular dichroism of A1g phonons was observed under magnetic fields due to spin-phonon coupling.

why_it_matters.zh: 它为区分激子绝缘体与电荷密度波提供了关键实验证据，并展示了圆偏振拉曼光谱作为探测磁性激子系统中自旋-声子耦合和短程磁关联的敏感手段。
why_it_matters.en: It provides crucial experimental evidence to distinguish excitonic insulators from charge density waves, and demonstrates circular-polarization Raman as a sensitive probe of spin-phonon coupling and short-range magnetic correlations in magnetic excitonic systems.

reason.zh: 澄清了GdGaI中能带重构的电子驱动本质，并阐明了磁场下A1g声子的圆二色性机制。
reason.en: Clarified the electronically driven nature of band reconstruction in GdGaI and elucidated the mechanism of circular dichroism in A1g phonons under magnetic fields.

reason.zh: 该研究结合了激子绝缘体和手性声子两个凝聚态物理前沿热点，实验数据详实且有理论支持，适合发表于高水平物理期刊。
reason.en: The study combines two hot topics in condensed matter physics (excitonic insulators and chiral phonons) with solid experimental data and theoretical support, making it suitable for a high-level physics journal.
